suite: Suite PR #564 (FDP Accelerator and Project Management Pro Full precision switch and PMP As of input, stacked on #554)

intermediate.append: Read the figures in the FDP Accelerator with its Full precision switch on (at the top of the page): it prints them to the precision this capstone grades, with no digit grouping.
intermediate.why: The Wells table prints well cost in $MM at 1 decimal (a 37500 USD miss) and the facility cards $MM at 1 decimal.

ukot_uk01_well_cost_usd.evidence: With Full precision on, prints at 0 decimals (jest: fdp/__tests__/w3FullPrecision.test.jsx, calculateDrillingCost through formatFull, checked against the key first).
